hook: AI keeps giving you 5-step bullet lists when you just needed one sentence. Here's why.
caption:
AI keeps giving you 5-step bullet lists when you just needed one sentence. Here's why.

Most AI tools default to a "thorough" response template. Headers. Bullets. A summary at the end. Looks helpful. Feels exhausting.

Here's the problem: thorough for a researcher looks completely different from thorough for a founder who reads at 2x speed between meetings.

The AI isn't wrong. It just doesn't know you.

It doesn't know you hate filler phrases like "Certainly! Great question!"

It doesn't know you want the answer first and the reasoning after — not a three-paragraph windup.

It doesn't know you'd rather get a blunt "this won't work because X" than a diplomatic sandwich of maybe-yes-maybe-no.

So it guesses. And its default guess is: wall of structured text.

The fix isn't reprompting every single time. That's exhausting and you'll stop doing it within a week.

The fix is an instruction profile that travels with you — so the AI already knows you prefer direct, already knows your context, already knows not to explain things you didn't ask it to explain.

That's what bootfile.ai builds for you.

One profile. Every session starts knowing how you think.
